name: JMS Map Message To Payload Converter
helpText: Converts a JMS MapMessage into an FTP/SFTP Payload. This accepts a JMS message, not a plain Java Map. Content may be String (encoded with the runtime JVM default charset) or byte[] (preserved unchanged); missing or other content types fail conversion. By default content is read from content, and both payload ID and filename from fileName. Configure the ID field as id when using a sender that provides that key. Also reads referencePayload and relativePath; arbitrary message fields are not copied.

componentName.helpText: The component name displayed on the canvas. It must be unique within the flow.

contentAttributeName.helpText: Name of the JMS map entry holding String or byte[] content.

idAttributeName.helpText: Name of the JMS map entry used as the payload ID. Use id to read an explicit ID field.

fileNameAttributeName.helpText: Name of the JMS map entry used as the output fileName attribute.

configurationId.helpText: Configuration resource ID. Keep stable when reusing runtime configuration overrides.
